line: Three questions, right after the talk. Listen well.
First: in Rwanda, vehicles drive on the right-hand side of the road. Keep right, always.
Second: when an officer is directing traffic, the officer's instructions come before the signs and the traffic lights.
Third: if an officer signals you to stop, you stop. Refusing to stop is an offence with a heavy fine and even prison.
